DANC 101.description: An eclectic survey of various dance forms including primitive, historic, ballet, modern, and Broadway musical.
DANC 101.subject: DANC
DANC 101.title: Dance Appreciation

DANC 102.description: An introduction to ballet technique. May be repeated up to six times for credit.
DANC 102.subject: DANC
DANC 102.title: Ballet Technique I

DANC 103.description: Anatomy and movement analysis for dancers.
DANC 103.subject: DANC
DANC 103.title: The Dancer's Body

DANC 111.description: A study of global dance forms from multiple cultural, historical, and aesthetic contexts. May be repeated up to 6 times for credit.
DANC 111.subject: DANC
DANC 111.title: Global Dance Forms

DANC 112.description: An introduction to modern and contemporary dance techniques. May be repeated up to six times for credit.
DANC 112.subject: DANC
DANC 112.title: Contemporary Dance Technique I

DANC 150.description: Introduction to dance as art, communication, and cultural expression as it applies to a career in dance.
DANC 150.subject: DANC
DANC 150.title: Introduction to Dance

DANC 160A.description: Introduction to dance composition and the creative process for dance majors. Exploration and improvisation of different dance forms; use of specific choreographic tools. May be repeated up to six times for credit.
DANC 160A.subject: DANC
DANC 160A.title: Dance Improvisation and Composition

DANC 160B.description: Introduction to dance composition and the creative process for dance minors and non dance majors. Exploration and improvisation of different dance forms; use of specific choreographic tools. May be repeated up to six times for credit.
DANC 160B.subject: DANC
DANC 160B.title: Dance Improvisation and Composition

DANC 170.description: Introduction of six major dances (Foxtrot, Waltz, Tango, Cha Cha, Swing, and Rumba) to students with no dance experience. The emphasis will be on learning dance figures and patterns.
DANC 170.subject: DANC
DANC 170.title: Ballroom Dance I

DANC 171.description: Intermediate steps will include challenging choreography or patterns. The emphasis in technique will be based on developing speed and elegance while dancing complex patterns.
DANC 171.subject: DANC
DANC 171.title: Ballroom Dance II

DANC 177.description: Rehearsals by performers for the student showcase of original dance choreography. May be repeated up to seven times for credit.
DANC 177.subject: DANC
DANC 177.title: Student Choreography Showcase/Performer

DANC 178.description: An introduction to jazz technique. May be repeated up to six times for credit.
DANC 178.subject: DANC
DANC 178.title: Jazz Dance Technique I

DANC 202A.description: Intermediate level of classical ballet technique. This course is for dance majors. May be repeated up to six times for credit.
DANC 202A.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in DANC 102.
DANC 202A.subject: DANC
DANC 202A.title: Ballet Technique II

DANC 202B.description: Intermediate level of classical ballet technique. This course is for dance minors and non dance majors. May be repeated up to six times for credit.
DANC 202B.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in DANC 102.
DANC 202B.subject: DANC
DANC 202B.title: Ballet Technique II

DANC 204.description: Intermediate study of pointe technique. May be repeated four times.
DANC 204.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in DANC 202 or equivalent.
DANC 204.subject: DANC
DANC 204.title: Intermediate Pointe Technique

DANC 212A.description: Intermediate modern dance technique for dance majors. May be repeated up to six times for credit.
DANC 212A.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in DANC 112 or placement audition.
DANC 212A.subject: DANC
DANC 212A.title: Modern Dance Technique

DANC 212B.description: Intermediate modern dance technique for dance minors and non dance majors. May be repeated up to six times for credit.
DANC 212B.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in DANC 112 or placement audition.
DANC 212B.subject: DANC
DANC 212B.title: Modern Dance Technique

DANC 260.description: An examination of Laban Movement analysis – a language for understanding, observing, describing and notating all forms of movement. Experiential, analytical and performance teaching methods will be used.
DANC 260.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in DANC 160A or DANC 160B.
DANC 260.subject: DANC
DANC 260.title: Laban Movement Practices

DANC 270.description: An overview of state and national standards, theoretical and philosophical perspectives that shape current practices for teaching dance in K-12 environments, and arts/dance education advocacy.
DANC 270.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C+ or better in DANC 150 and DANC 160A.
DANC 270.subject: DANC
DANC 270.title: Introduction to Dance Education

DANC 277.description: Rehearsals for the student choreography showcase. Student choreographers will create original dance choreography on student dancers. This course is for choreographers only. May be repeated up to four times for credit.
DANC 277.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in DANC 160A and DANC 360.
DANC 277.subject: DANC
DANC 277.title: Student Choreography Showcase/Choreographer

DANC 278.description: Intermediate level jazz dance technique. May be repeated up to six times for credit.
DANC 278.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in DANC 178.
DANC 278.subject: DANC
DANC 278.title: Jazz Dance Technique II

DANC 281.description: Overview of the development of dance through the 19th century.
DANC 281.subject: DANC
DANC 281.title: Dance History I

DANC 282.description: Development of dance from the 20th century to the present.
DANC 282.subject: DANC
DANC 282.title: Dance History II

DANC 302.description: Intermediate/advanced third level of classical ballet technique for dance majors. May be repeated up to six times for credit.
DANC 302.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in DANC 202A.
DANC 302.subject: DANC
DANC 302.title: Ballet Technique III

DANC 303.description: Advanced study in pointe technique. Study and execution of variations from classical repertory. May be repeated four times.
DANC 303.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in DANC 202 or equivalent.
DANC 303.subject: DANC
DANC 303.title: Advanced Pointe Technique

DANC 304.description: The study of intermediate level tap dance.
DANC 304.subject: DANC
DANC 304.title: Tap Dance

DANC 307.description: The history and practice of indigenous West African dance.
DANC 307.subject: DANC
DANC 307.title: West African Dance

DANC 310.description: Theoretical practices and cultural perspectives of dance making.
DANC 310.subject: DANC
DANC 310.title: Dance Analysis and Criticism

DANC 312.description: Intermediate/advanced level of contemporary and modern dance techniques. May be repeated up to six times for credit.
DANC 312.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in DANC 212A.
DANC 312.subject: DANC
DANC 312.title: Contemporary Dance Technique

DANC 360.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in DANC 160A or DANC 160B; recommend students to have completed at least three semesters of technique.
DANC 360.subject: DANC
DANC 360.title: Choreography I

DANC 370.description: An introduction to motor development, movement concepts, elements, and skills that contribute to lesson planning, instruction, and assessment of creative dance in K-12 education.
DANC 370.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C+ or better in DANC 160A or DANC 160B and DANC 360; it is recommended that students have completed at least three semesters of ballet and contemporary technique and world dance.
DANC 370.subject: DANC
DANC 370.title: Creative Dance

DANC 376.description: Rehearsals for the dance company concerts with faculty and guest artists. This course is for dance majors. May be repeated up to seven times for credit.
DANC 376.subject: DANC
DANC 376.title: Faculty/Guest Artist Dance Company

DANC 378.description: Study of Hip Hop movement vocabulary. May be repeated up to six times for credit.
DANC 378.subject: DANC
DANC 378.title: Hip Hop

DANC 380.description: Styles of movement and dance in musical theatre from the ‘20s, ‘30s, and ‘40s to modern contemporary musical theatre. Choreographing for musicals, cultural forms of dance, staging for vocal pieces.
DANC 380.subject: DANC
DANC 380.title: Movement and Dance for Musical Theatre

DANC 399.description: Contract approved by instructor, advisor, and department chair is required for undergraduate students.
DANC 399.subject: DANC
DANC 399.title: Independent Study and Research

DANC 402.description: Intensive fourth level of classical ballet technique for dance majors. May be repeated up to six times for credit.
DANC 402.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in DANC 302.
DANC 402.subject: DANC
DANC 402.title: Ballet Technique IV

DANC 412.description: Advanced level contemporary dance technique. This course is for dance majors. May be repeated up to six times for credit.
DANC 412.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in DANC 312.
DANC 412.subject: DANC
DANC 412.title: Advanced Contemporary Dance Technique

DANC 440.description: Exploration of current classical and contemporary partnering techniques.
DANC 440.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in DANC 302 and DANC 312 or equivalent.
DANC 440.subject: DANC
DANC 440.title: Partnering

DANC 460.description: An intermediate level choreography and composition course.
DANC 460.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in DANC 360 and three semesters of technique courses.
DANC 460.subject: DANC
DANC 460.title: Choreography II

DANC 470.description: Intensive study of content and strategies for teaching dance in middle and high school with particular emphasis on curriculum development, instruction, and assessment.
DANC 470.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C+ or better in DANC 160A or DANC 160B, DANC 360 and DANC 370.
DANC 470.subject: DANC
DANC 470.title: Dance Pedagogy for Middle and High School

DANC 471.description: Seminar allows students to synthesize content and skills from all previous dance and education coursework in conjunction with their student teaching experience.
DANC 471.subject: DANC
DANC 471.title: Internship Seminar in Dance Education

DANC 476.description: Technical theatre functions, the structure and purpose of production design, and stage production as it relates to the whole of dance and theatrical performance.
DANC 476.subject: DANC
DANC 476.title: Production Design for Dance

DANC 478.description: Study and application of strategies for teaching diverse learners, implementation of instructional technology in the dance classroom, and dance/arts integration.
DANC 478.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C+ or better in DANC 370 and DANC 470.
DANC 478.subject: DANC
DANC 478.title: Integrated Approaches in Dance Education

DANC 479.description: Practical demonstration of pedagogical knowledge, skill, and dispositions necessary to effectively teach in K-12 dance education as defined and measured by CAEP and ADEPT standards.
DANC 479.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: Must have fulfilled all other program requirements except DANC 471 (and DANC 479), be admitted to the professional program, and approved for student teaching.
DANC 479.subject: DANC
DANC 479.title: Teaching Internship in Dance Education

DANC 480.description: Preparation for senior project encompassing a choreographic work or research thesis.
DANC 480.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in DANC 160A or DANC 160B; C or better in DANC 360.
DANC 480.subject: DANC
DANC 480.title: Senior Capstone Preparation

DANC 490.description: Culmination of the performance/choregraphy dance emphasis. Senior project encompassing a choreographic work or research thesis.
DANC 490.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in DANC 480 and DANC 360.
DANC 490.subject: DANC
DANC 490.title: Senior Capstone Dance Project

DANC 500.description: Topics are announced in the class schedule for each semester.
DANC 500.subject: DANC
DANC 500.title: Selected Topics in Dance

DANC 573.description: Individual advanced training in movement, improvisation, flexibility, and precision in dance styles including modern and ballet.
DANC 573.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: graduate standing or three credits in dance.
DANC 573.subject: DANC
DANC 573.title: Dancer's Workshop

DANC 599.description: Reading and research on selected topics. Course content varies and will be announced in the schedule of classes by title. May be repeated once as topics vary.
DANC 599.subject: DANC
DANC 599.title: Special Topics in Dance

DANC 700.description: Development of dance literacy through exploration and application of Language of Dance and other Laban concepts in artistic, pedagogical, and scholarly contexts.
DANC 700.subject: DANC
DANC 700.title: Dance Literacy Foundations

DANC 702.description: Continued development of dance literacy through the application of Language of Dance and other Laban concepts to artistic, pedagogical, and/or scholarly contexts that will lead to earning the Foundations 1 certificate through the Language of Dance Center, USA.
DANC 702.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in DANC 700.
DANC 702.subject: DANC
DANC 702.title: Dance Literacy Applications

DANC 705.description: Kinesthetic study of global dance forms from various cultural, historical, and aesthetic contexts.
DANC 705.subject: DANC
DANC 705.title: Global Dance Forms

DANC 710.description: An exploration of the choreographic practice as an individual artist, collaborator, and mentor.
DANC 710.subject: DANC
DANC 710.title: Choreography: Creative Practice and Pedagogy

DANC 715.description: Part I of a two-part course. Functional anatomy of the human body, including skeletal and muscular systems, and applications to the moving body in a dance environment.
DANC 715.subject: DANC
DANC 715.title: Functional Anatomy Foundations

DANC 718.description: Part II of a two-part course. Functional anatomy of the human body, including skeletal and muscular systems, and applications to the moving body in a dance environment.
DANC 718.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in DANC 715.
DANC 718.subject: DANC
DANC 718.title: Functional Anatomy Applied Practice

DANC 720.description: An investigation of current and enduring philosophical, theoretical, and practical issues relevant to dance theory, practice, and pedagogy.
DANC 720.subject: DANC
DANC 720.title: Analysis of Scholarly Literature in Dance

DANC 725.description: Study in the knowledge and skills needed to analyze arts/arts education policy in the United States, participate in arts advocacy, and write successful grants to procure funding.
DANC 725.subject: DANC
DANC 725.title: Arts Policy, Advocacy, and Funding

DANC 730.description: An investigation into the neuroscience of perception, movement, and cognition as they relate to and inform dance and dance education.
DANC 730.subject: DANC
DANC 730.title: Neuroscience for Dance Teaching and Performance

DANC 735.description: An exploration of theories and practices of world dance history and traditions in their cultural and historical period contexts; and as they influence current dance pedagogy and performance.
DANC 735.subject: DANC
DANC 735.title: Histories of Dance

DANC 745.description: Study of various methods for curriculum design in dance for implementation in a variety of artistic and educational settings.
DANC 745.subject: DANC
DANC 745.title: Curriculum Design for Dance

DANC 750.description: An investigation of critical theory in dance education scholarship, its influence on pedagogical practices in dance, and how to implement them in teaching/learning dance.
DANC 750.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in DANC 745.
DANC 750.subject: DANC
DANC 750.title: Critical Issues in Dance Pedagogy

DANC 776.description: Technical theatre functions, the structure and purpose of production design and stage production as it relates to the entirety of dance and theatrical performance.
DANC 776.subject: DANC
DANC 776.title: Production Design for Dance

DANC 790.description: An investigation of qualitative, quantitative, and arts-based research methodologies used in scholarly, educational, and artistic research in dance.
DANC 790.subject: DANC
DANC 790.title: Research Methods in Dance

DANC 795.description: An opportunity to conduct research, under faculty supervision, that will contribute to a culminating thesis project.
DANC 795.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in DANC 790.
DANC 795.subject: DANC
DANC 795.title: Dance Thesis Preparation

DANC 799.description: An opportunity to develop and present a culminating research project in dance based on disciplinary and professional interests.
DANC 799.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in DANC 790.
DANC 799.subject: DANC
DANC 799.title: Thesis Project in Dance
